lines.zh: 轻轻滑翔，翅膀扇动轻盈。
lines.en: Gentle glide, wings flap lightly.

lines.zh: 幼蛇的身体在草丛中穿梭。
lines.en: Young snake slithers through the grass.

lines.zh: 爬行着接近，小爪子轻触地面。
lines.en: Creeping close, little claws touch the ground.

lines.zh: 在灌木间穿梭，尾巴摆动。
lines.en: Slithering through the bushes, tail swaying.

lines.zh: 用小鼻孔嗅着周围的气息。
lines.en: Sniffing the air with tiny nostrils.

lines.zh: 在水面下缓慢游动，尾巴划过。
lines.en: Slowly swimming underwater, tail flicking.
Creeping slowly along the branches.

lines.zh: 轻轻跳跃，从一丛草跳到另一丛。
lines.en: Gentle jump from one bush to another.

lines.zh: 滑行在树干上，爪子触碰木皮。
lines.en: Sliding along the trunk, claws touch the bark.

lines.zh: 在草地上蜿蜒前行，尾巴摆动。
lines.en: Winding along the grass, tail swaying.
My small body parts the water surface.
My tail makes loops in the water.
I creep along the riverbed.
I slip around the weeds without breaking them.
Half my head breaks the surface for air.
My scales carry a wet sheen.
I twist forward across the shallows.
Rings of ripples spread out behind me.

lines.zh: 静静地躺在阳光下晒暖身子。
lines.en: Lying still in the sun to warm up.
Waiting quietly for prey to pass.

lines.zh: 盘绕在树根旁，等待时机。
lines.en: Coiling around the tree roots, waiting.
Drifting leisurely on the water surface.
Waiting quietly for a companion to appear.

lines.zh: 蜷缩在岩石缝隙中休息。
lines.en: Curling up in the rock crevice to rest.
Floating on the water surface, enjoying peace.
Waiting quietly for night to fall.
Lying under the leaves to cool off.
I poke my head above the water and wait.
I coil my body into a knot.
Only my snout shows above the water.
I listen quietly to the water.
The sun warms my back.
I wait for a small fish to swim close.
I hide in a rock crevice without a sound.
Eagerly lift head to look at the player.

lines.zh: 迅速扭头，注意玩家动向。
lines.en: Swiftly turn head to watch the player.

lines.zh: 我从水里探出半个头看你。
lines.en: I poke half my head out of the water at you.
Alertly scanning the player.

lines.zh: 谨慎地朝玩家方向看去。
lines.en: Cautiously looking towards the player.

lines.zh: 凝视着玩家，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Staring at the player, seemingly in thought.
Quickly turn head to find the player.

lines.zh: 警惕地观察玩家的动作。
lines.en: Alertly observing the player's movements.
Eyes flashing, staring at the player.
I poke my small head out of the water.
You are too big; I dare not come close.
I flick my tail and hide deeper.
Baby Palaeolophis is hurt.

lines.zh: 古杯蛇的小生命受创了。
lines.en: The baby Palaeolophis is injured.
Baby Palaeolophis got hurt.
Injured baby Palaeolophis.
Baby Palaeolophis is injured.
Injured baby Palaeolophis.
Baby Palaeolophis is wounded.
Baby Palaeolophis is hurt.
Injured baby Palaeolophis.
Baby Palaeolophis is injured.

lines.zh: 好奇地靠近你，轻声嘶嘶叫着。
lines.en: Closes in curiously, hisses softly.

lines.zh: 用头轻轻触碰你，试探着。
lines.en: Touches you gently with its head.

lines.zh: 好奇地打量你，发出轻微嘶声。
lines.en: Gazes at you, making a soft hiss.
Approaches you, seeking food.

lines.zh: 嗅着你，寻找可食用物品。
lines.en: Sniffs at you, searching for edibles.

lines.zh: 用嘴尝试咬你，表达兴趣。
lines.en: Bites you with its mouth, showing interest.

lines.zh: 试探性地接近，寻求互动。
lines.en: Approaches tentatively, seeking interaction.
Sweeps its tail, gaining attention.

lines.zh: 发出轻微嘶嘶声，吸引注意。
lines.en: Hisses softly, drawing attention.

lines.zh: 好奇地绕你转圈，寻找食物。
lines.en: Circles you, searching for food.
There are small fish in the water, and you have some too.
That thing is moving. I've got my eyes on it.
I swim a little closer, just a little.

lines.zh: 你的手在水里像块石头。
lines.en: Your hand looks like a stone in the water.
Only in water do I have strength.
Hold still, let me circle you once.
Collides suddenly, trying to intimidate you.
Collides with you, expressing dissatisfaction.
Collides forcefully, trying to scare you away.

lines.zh: 用头部撞击你，表达愤怒。
lines.en: Collides with your head, expressing anger.

lines.zh: 身体碰撞，试图摆脱干扰。
lines.en: Collides to shake off disturbance.
Collides forcefully, making a threat.

lines.zh: 猛烈撞击，试图阻止你接近。
lines.en: Collides to stop your approach.

lines.zh: 用头部猛烈撞击你，表达攻击意图。
lines.en: Collides with your head, expressing attack intent.

lines.zh: 身体快速撞击，试图击退你。
lines.en: Collides quickly, trying to push you away.
Collides forcefully, giving a warning.

lines.zh: 发出求偶嘶嘶声，吸引伴侣。
lines.en: Hisses to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 靠近另一只，发出求偶声。
lines.en: Approaches another, making mating sounds.
Taps another with its head, mating.

lines.zh: 发出轻微嘶嘶声，表达求偶意图。
lines.en: Hisses softly, indicating mating intent.
Approaches, hissing to mate.

lines.zh: 发出求偶嘶嘶声，吸引配偶。
lines.en: Hisses to attract a mate.
Approaches, making mating sounds.
Taps with its head, indicating mating.

lines.zh: 发出求偶嘶嘶声，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Hisses to find a mate.
Kin beneath the water, answer me.

lines.zh: 我紧紧贴着地面，寻找着可口的植物。
lines.en: I stick to the ground, seeking tasty plants.

lines.zh: 幼嫩的叶子是我最爱的食物。
lines.en: Young leaves are my favorite.

lines.zh: 这里环境适宜，我在这里定居。
lines.en: This place suits me, I settle here.

lines.zh: 我的皮可以制作蜕鳞护甲。
lines.en: My skin can make蜕鳞护甲.
Don't bother me, I'm fragile.

lines.zh: 这些花朵散发着甜美的香气。
lines.en: These flowers emit sweet fragrance.

lines.zh: 我的叫声吸引了远处的同伴。
lines.en: My call attracts distant companions.

lines.zh: 这石头中蕴藏着珍贵的蛋白石。
lines.en: This stone contains precious quartz.

lines.zh: 我用叫声标记自己的领地。
lines.en: I use calls to mark my territory.
A foe's call comes from afar.
I sense prey's scent.

lines.zh: 猎物就在附近，我将捕获它。
lines.en: Prey nearby, I'll catch it.
I creep near, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 它不敢靠近，我准备攻击。
lines.en: It dares not approach, I'm ready to attack.

lines.zh: 我要用锋利的牙齿咬住它。
lines.en: I'll bite it with sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它的叫声让我更加警觉。
lines.en: Its call makes me more vigilant.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴轻轻敲击水面。
lines.en: I tap the surface with my tail.
I lock onto the target with my gaze.

lines.zh: 我感受到了潜在的危险。
lines.en: I sense potential danger.

lines.zh: 我准备用毒液进行攻击。
lines.en: I'm ready to attack with venom.

lines.zh: 我会注视着它，直到捕获它。
lines.en: I'll stare until I catch it.

lines.zh: 我需要确保它在视野中。
lines.en: I need to keep it in sight.

lines.zh: 不要让它从我视线中消失。
lines.en: Don't let it out of my sight.

lines.zh: 我用目光锁定它的位置。
lines.en: I lock its position with my gaze.

lines.zh: 我保持警惕，确保它的位置不变。
lines.en: I remain vigilant, ensuring its position.
I must watch it constantly.

lines.zh: 我要确保它的位置没有变化。
lines.en: I need to ensure its position hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 我不会让它从我的视线中溜走。
lines.en: I won't let it slip from my sight.

lines.zh: 我用目光锁定它的每一个动作。
lines.en: I lock onto every movement with my gaze.

lines.zh: 我会持续注视着它，直到它成为我的猎物。
lines.en: I'll stare until it becomes my prey.

lines.zh: 我这条小蛇，牙已经能咬。
lines.en: Small snake, but my fangs already bite.
Baby Palaeolophis, go away!
In water I'm faster than anyone. I bite.
My scales can make armor!
Don't touch me, it's dangerous!
My hiss will scare you!
My speed will outrun you!
I coil at the bottom; do not reach in.
Small snake fangs still carry venom.
My shed is valuable!
Another baby Palaeolophis in the sand!
A baby Palaeolophis hatched from the sand!
A baby Palaeolophis awakens in the sand!
A baby Palaeolophis has been born in the sand!
A baby Palaeolophis is hatching in the sand!
A new baby Palaeolophis joins the sand!
A baby Palaeolophis grows in the sand!

lines.zh: 幼蛇在沙地里苏醒过来！
lines.en: A baby Palaeolophis awakens from the sand!

lines.zh: 幼蛇在沙地里孵化出来！
lines.en: A baby Palaeolophis hatches from the sand!

lines.zh: 幼蛇在沙地里破壳而出！
lines.en: A baby Palaeolophis hatches from the sand!
A small snake slips out into the shallows.
An egg on the riverbed stirs.
The baby Palaeolophis is burned by fire.
Baby Palaeolophis fell and is injured.

lines.zh: 幼小的古杯蛇溺水受伤。
lines.en: Baby Palaeolophis drowned and is injured.

lines.zh: 幼小的古杯蛇被爆炸伤了。
lines.en: Baby Palaeolophis is injured by explosion.

lines.zh: 幼小的古杯蛇被投射物伤了。
lines.en: Baby Palaeolophis is injured by projectile.

lines.zh: 幼小的古杯蛇被魔法伤了。
lines.en: Baby Palaeolophis is injured by magic.
Baby Palaeolophis is starved and injured.

lines.zh: 幼小的古杯蛇被闪电击伤。
lines.en: Baby Palaeolophis is injured by lightning.

lines.zh: 幼小的古杯蛇掉入了虚无空间。
lines.en: Baby Palaeolophis fell into the void and is injured.
